kicker: A reading list that benchmarks itself

scenes.headline: How a CPU core spends its cycles
scenes.sub: One mechanism per benchmark, each timed against a measured ceiling.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pico! This repo is a reading list on CPU performance that ships its own benchmarks. Each one isolates one mechanism.

scenes.text: Every number is set by one limit: a latency chain, a mispredict, a cache level or the memory roof. Find which one binds before you optimise.
scenes.say: The idea: every timing is set by one limit. Find the one that binds before you change anything.

scenes.title: The same adds, two dependency graphs

left.title: One accumulator
items: Each add waits for the last one
left.say: With one accumulator, every add waits for the last. The loop runs at the latency of one add.

right.title: Sixteen accumulators
right.say: Spread the adds over sixteen accumulators and the chains overlap. About eight times faster.

scenes.title: One dependent load, three places to live

steps.note: random pointer chase, one load at a time
steps.say: A pointer chase follows a random cycle, one load at a time. In level one cache, a load costs three cycles.

steps.note: an L2 hit is 8.9 times an L1 hit
steps.say: In level two, about nine times that.

steps.note: translation misses arrive before L2 runs out
steps.say: In memory, about a hundred and eighty times. And address translation runs out before the cache does.

scenes.title: How llama.cpp multiplies a q4_0 block

steps.say: A four-bit block packs thirty-two weights into eighteen bytes. The kernel unpacks the nibbles.
The activations are eight-bit too, so one integer dot instruction does sixteen multiply-adds.
Each integer sum is scaled and added up in floating point.

scenes.title: Which roof binds decode
scenes.say: At batch one, decode uses each weight once.

parts.say: Divide by the bytes each weight costs.

parts.note: ridge: 5.00 on ten cores, 1.55 on one
parts.say: On ten cores, decode sits under the memory roof. On one core, the arithmetic starts to matter.

scenes.title: SGEMM on one P-core
scenes.note: Accelerate runs on the SME matrix unit
scenes.say: A packed microkernel takes a naive loop to the vector unit's ceiling. The vendor library goes further, on a matrix unit plain C cannot reach.

scenes.label: the cost of one mispredicted branch on this core
scenes.note: unsorted against sorted data, same instructions
scenes.say: And a branch costs what it mispredicts: about nineteen cycles a miss.

scenes.text: Measure the ceiling you quote against: sixteen chains reach 128.8 GFLOP/s, twenty reach 143.7.
scenes.say: Measure the ceiling you quote against. Sixteen chains are not the peak here. Twenty are.

recap: Cache levels and TLBs price every load
Decode lives under the memory roof
scenes.say: Chains, caches and bytes. Find the limit that binds, then measure it.
